description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'BaseCustomizableValidator' which provides validation utilities for 'Customizable' subclasses in the OpenMRS framework. It focuses on validating attributes based on their types and occurrence constraints, ensuring data integrity for customizable entities.

classes.name: BaseCustomizableValidator
classes.description: An abstract class providing validation logic for Customizable objects, ensuring correct attribute occurrence and value validation.

methods.name: validateAttributes
methods.description: Validates the attributes of a Customizable object, checking for min/max occurrence constraints and attribute validity.
